paragraphs.text:
One warrior lifts his rifle to his shoulder and fires. The others 
follow suit.

A total of 1D6+2 riflemen attack you. They each have 20% (10/4) 
skill  with  their  obsolete  rifles,  which  deal  2D6  damage  and  can 
impale on an Extreme success. Your group may exchange shots with 
them until at least half the hunters have been successfully hit, or 
until wounds or good sense force your party to surrender. If half or

99
more of the hunters are hit, they flee. Your party may attempt to heal 
by using First Aid to gain 1D3 hit points; then, go to 513. If you 
surrender (at any point), go to 561.
